description: Beginner secure presets shared by the bridge setup API, the Android onboarding and the web demo. Region from country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, uppercase); role presets follow docs/design/ux-help-system.md 5.

client.description: Phone, laptop or handheld; sends and receives, shares position only when asked.

tracker.description: Battery-conscious position beacon (bike, boat, pet, hiker).

repeater.description: Solar/roof relay that extends range and holds encrypted mail for offline nodes.

gateway.description: Bridges the local mesh to a backbone or another network.

security.notes: Secure defaults for quick setup: token auth on, panel loopback-only, no open backbone mode, position sharing private unless the role needs it.

media.position_note: Position sharing 'private' means only manual/direct shares; 'channel' shares to the node's channels; 'off' disables.
